title: Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation: Wall Mounting Added After Booking
content:
Under Northgate Delivery & Installation, wall mounting that a member adds to a Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation appointment after its booking date is booked on the member's own authorization as one wall-mount labor entry dated the posting date, with the appointment's currently booked delivery date as its service date.

Mounting added this way covers every television the appointment delivers, and the entry carries as its units the televisions mounted, which are the television units sold on the purchase being delivered less the television units returned from it. The crew's mounting limits on screen size and wall construction still apply at the door.

Where the appointment's road miles exceed the included radius, the wall-mounting charge is fixed only after the appointment carries its extended-distance entry.

On an appointment moved more times than its free reschedules, wall mounting is booked only after the appointment carries a reschedule fee entry for every move beyond them.

## Points of judgement

- **Who authorizes?** The member, personally; the mounting is booked on the member's own authorization.
- **Which televisions?** Every television the appointment delivers. A purchase with three televisions sold and one returned has two televisions mounted, and the entry carries 2 as its units.
- **What date does the entry carry?** It is dated the day it is posted, and its service date is the delivery date the appointment is booked for at that time.
- **Do the crew's limits still apply?** Yes. Screen-size and wall-construction limits are applied at the door.
- **Road miles beyond the included radius?** The wall-mounting charge is fixed only once the appointment carries its extended-distance entry.
- **Moved more times than its free reschedules?** Wall mounting is booked only once a reschedule fee entry stands on the appointment for every move beyond the free reschedules.

## Member authorization tool: `authorize_wall_mounting_3e376943`

**What it does.** The member authorizes wall mounting on their own TV delivery appointment: the member adds the crew's wall-mount installation for the televisions the appointment delivers and accepts its labor charge, which lands as one wall-mount labor entry on the appointment. On success the appointment's fee history shows a new wall-mount labor charge for the amount and the number of televisions given, posted today and tied to the appointment date given, and the crew is booked to mount those televisions on the delivery date.

**How it is invoked.** This is the member's own tool. The representative unlocks `authorize_wall_mounting_3e376943` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | The member's own customer reference number, as read out to the member from the customer lookup by the representative | Identifier |
| `delivery_id` | The reference number of the member's delivery appointment, as read out to the member from the delivery appointment lookup by the representative | Identifier |
| `service_date` | The appointment date the mounting relates to | YYYY-MM-DD calendar date, no time or time zone; never empty |
| `televisions` | The billing units of the entry: the number of televisions to be mounted | Whole positive integer |
| `amount` | The wall-mount labor charge the member accepts, in USD | 2 decimal places, always positive; stored rounded to the cent |

**Return.** On success the tool returns a description of the authorized entry: `status` ("authorized"), `delivery_charge_id` (the new fee entry's reference number), `delivery_id` (the appointment charged), `charge_type` (always `wall_mount_labor`), `units` (the televisions to be mounted, an integer), `amount` (the charge in USD, 2 decimal places), `event_date` (the posting date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `service_date` (the appointment date the mounting relates to, YYYY-MM-DD).
